title: LOOK: Iloilo BPO workers evacuate amid 5.1-magnitude Antique tremor

blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Employees of a business process outsourcing (BPO) company along Benigno Aquino Jr. Avenue (Diversion Road) in Mandurriao District here evacuated and gathered outside their building after a magnitude 5.1 earthquake that jolted Western Visayas Wednesday morning. According to Earthquake Information No. 1 issued by the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), the tectonic tremor struck at exactly 7:29 a.m. The epicenter was located 14 kilometers southeast of Valderrama, Antique, at a shallow depth of 10 kilometers.
